title: Nucleus pulposus ECM remodelling: figure reproduction code and frozen plotting inputs
description:
Python drawing code and frozen processed inputs for seven main figures and 24 supplementary figures examining fibrocartilage-like extracellular matrix remodelling in human nucleus pulposus-related cells. The figures distinguish the relative abundance of a remodelling state, expression within that state and bulk-tissue signals.

This software release redraws completed results. It does not rerun the original raw-data quality control, clustering, statistical inference or upstream multi-omics pipelines. The frozen inputs comprise processed tables, UMAP coordinates, categorical palettes and caption definitions; original large expression matrices are not included.

The source distribution contains code and frozen plotting inputs. The complete Windows x86-64 distribution additionally contains Python 3.12.14 and installed dependencies for offline reproduction. MIT applies to original project code and documentation only. Source-data reuse conditions and third-party software licenses remain applicable and are described in Reuse.txt and the bundled software metadata.
